acceptance_criteria: Main views make prediction and uncertainty primary, show specialization only if admitted or global-only otherwise, and never calculate independent client-side percentages/scores.
The declared output `artifacts/product/dashboard_contract_test.json` is produced with deterministic identity, provenance, and validation metadata appropriate to this work.
The work does not fabricate source availability, empirical results, thresholds, model performance, operational readiness, or completion evidence.

BAS is explicitly underperformance versus valid pregame expected margin—not loss probability—witty copy is separate from science, and thresholds/components appear only when supported with uncertainty.
The declared output `artifacts/product/bas_presentation_validation.json` is produced with deterministic identity, provenance, and validation metadata appropriate to this work.
Every displayed value traces to a snapshot field and loading/stale/blocked/missing/no-champion/null-effect/source-outage states are accessible and keyboard/screen-reader understandable.
All prerequisite evidence is linked and unresolved blockers remain explicit; file creation alone cannot pass this gate.
